label: No contingent concrete supporter of a necessary concretum at the selected world
term: no contingent concrete supporter at the selected world
definition: ActualNoContingentConcreteSupport m w holds when every concrete candidate that exists at w and stands, at w, in the selected relation to a concrete candidate existing at every world accessible from w is itself existing at every world accessible from w. It is the existing selected-world restriction ActualNoContingent instantiated on the concrete subtype (concreteOntic, concreteSupport), as J1 (DEF-NO-CONTINGENT-CONCRETE-SUPPORT) is the all-world condition instantiated there. Ordinary meaning: whatever here and now sustains the being of a necessary concrete thing is itself necessary. Orientation (not warrant): if the very thing that keeps a necessary being in existence here could have failed to exist, the necessary being's actual existence would be hostage to something that might not have been. This presupposes that the actual support is indispensable, which is not recorded as warranted (underived-essence-identity.md, Replaceable support, item 3: counterfactual deletion is not unrestricted replacement). Counter-patterns it forbids: a necessary concrete whole actually sustained by constituents that might not have existed, and a necessary concretum with a fixed essential supporter plus additional contingent (partial or redundant) contributors. It does not constrain supporters existing only at other worlds, or support edges at other worlds.
note: Analyst framework definition, attribution deferred; an open premise, not established. The weak version of J1 (STMT-NO-CONTINGENT-CONCRETE-SUPPORT): J1 quantifies the support world over every carrier world, this instance only over w. The strength order is verified (actualOfNoContingent) and strict (Control.offWorldContingent). Structural properties: constrains only actual incoming support of necessary concreta; says nothing about transitivity, asymmetry, well-foundedness or other worlds; holds vacuously when nothing actual supports a necessary concretum. Generalization from ordinary sustaining to the support of necessary beings is an explicit open bridge (see DEF-PRESENT-ESSE-SUPPORT). The recorded replaceable-support rival (STMT 501d1915) conflicts with it only when the contingent support is at w itself; no independent justification for that actual-world form is recorded (docs/notes/underived-essence-identity.md, Replaceable support), and no independent warrant for this premise is recorded either. See docs/notes/modal-spine.md, join rows.
